vb_textbox.text: Check the gnome hats colours and shapes. You may be able to find patterns when selecting them! Always remember to select them and pressing 'space' when the basket appears, as you'll most likely collect mushrooms if you do! In my case, it felt like purple and red hats would generally give more mushrooms, however be ready to change to the other colours if you see a decreasing/low amount of mushrooms collected.
